verdicts.reason: A does rearrange the layout into a blue header panel over a photo strip, and the text and logo are large and readable. But the diagonal stripes are left over the left edge of the photo, the photo is offset with a white gap on the left, the top-right corner has an odd white wedge, and the bottom quarter of the canvas is blank. B is just the original banner shrunk and letterboxed in the middle, with about 75% of the canvas empty white, so it was not resized for the new format at all.
